The two little dots beside a cat's anus are its "anal glands." The pheromones secreted by the anal glands can mark a cat's territory and intimidate its enemies.
Many plants are harmful to cats, such as lilies, pothos, and ivy.
Most cats dislike the scent of citrus.
90% of all cats have Type-A blood. Different cat breeds will have various distributions of blood types.
If you find little bumps on your cat's tummy, please don't try to yank them! Those might be the cat's nipples.
You can try changing the water in a cat's water bowl to warm water in the winter.
Many cats are lactose intolerant and will have an upset stomach if they drink milk. Therefore, they can only drink goat milk, sheep milk, or lactose-free cow milk.
Male cats usually look bigger than female cats due to testosterone.
Like human fingerprints, a cat's nose print is unique to each individual.
Please be careful to avoid the "quick," which is full of blood vessels and nerve endings, when trimming a cat's claws.
You can try feeding a cat probiotics if it is passing soft or runny stool. If symptoms persist, please take it to a vet ASAP.
Canned cat food is usually divided into snacks, supplements, or main meals. Please ensure you feed cats main meals on a daily basis to avoid malnutrition.
If your cat doesn't like to drink water, you can try using a wider bowl so the cat does not feel "whisker pressure" when drinking.
One cat, four paws, twenty toes: Scratch, scratch!
Cats' front paws have five claws each, but their hind paws only have four claws each.
Pyrethrin-based mosquito repellents, such as repellent incense, liquid, or pills, are all toxic to cats and may be lethal.
Catnip can, to a certain degree, function as a mosquito repellent.
Using enzyme-based cleaners that utilize proteases to break down uric acid is the only way to truly remove cat urine.
Ringworm appears luminescent green under UV-A light.
The average lifespan of a cat is 12 – 18 years. Please be a good companion to your cat.
A cat's water bowl and feeding bowl should be separated. That way, the cat food won't get wet from splashes of water and grow bacteria.
Cats like to drink fresh water. Change the water frequently to encourage your cat to drink water.
When multiple cats are in the same household, their food bowls should be placed apart. Having food bowls too close together can cause anxiety in cats and make them vomit.
A cat's water bowl and food bowl should be cleaned at least once a day to prevent bacterial growth and "Feline Acne."
Ceramic and stainless steel bowls are less likely to be scratched and can reduce bacterial growth.

If a cat starts passing soft stool and scratching after changing to a new food type, it might be having an allergic reaction. We suggest changing to a single-source meat diet, consisting mainly of chicken, and systematically checking for allergens.
Having a few snacks can make cats happy, while too many might hurt them. Eating too many snacks for too long can cause the cat to gain weight, become picky eaters, and become malnourished.
Theobromine and caffeine contained in chocolate, cocoa, and coffee are all toxic to cats. Please seek medical attention ASAP if your cat consumes them.
If the cat is not interested in the cat teaser in front of them, please try hiding it and making noises close by, while still hiding it from the cat. It works miracles.
When a cat slowly blinks at you, it's saying "I love you." Try slowly blinking back at it to show your love in return.
In a fight, the cat with its ears pressed against its head is usually at a disadvantage. A cat with ears popped up is declaring itself to be the stronger fighter.
The longest cat tail recorded by Guinness World Records was on a Maine Coon.
The longest cat whiskers recorded by Guinness World Records were on a Maine Coon.
The area between a cat's eyes and its ears contains scent glands. When a cat is rubbing its head against something, it is releasing pheromones and marking the area as its own.
Removing fur from the bottom of a cat's paws in summer can better dissipate heat and reduce slipping. It can also reduce bacterial growth on the feet.
Cats with blue eyes are rather rare, but some species only have blue eyes, such as Siamese Cats and Ragdolls…
Cats that have been desexed may experience an increase in appetite and a reduction in exercise, making it easier to gain weight. Monitor your cat's calorie intake after spaying or neutering.
Female cats that have not been spayed are seven times more likely to get breast cancer than those that have been spayed.
Cats prefer warmer canned food, probably because warmer food has a stronger scent.
If your cute cat has stinky farts, it might be due to stomach bloating. Try giving it fewer dairy products, fruits, or vegetables.
When a cat has its tail up and runs towards you, it's either saying "Hello, I like you!" or "Please play with me! Feed me!"
Not eating food for 24 hours can cause cats to develop fatty liver disease, which has a fatality rate as high as 78%. Please make sure your cat eats on time.

If your cat does not chew when it eats, please take it to get its oral cavity examined. If there are no issues, then you can try to holding the food that needs to be chewed so the cat must bite it off piece by piece.
The spikes on a cat's tongue are actually hollow. Cats can absorb saliva to wet their fur and use a twist of their tongue muscle to untangle their fur.
When a cat is anxious, you can try using pheromones to soothe it.
Pheromones are considered an information medium rather than a simple scent.
Cats have REM (rapid eye movement) sleep just like humans. They may twitch rapidly and slightly when sleeping.
Cats can get Alzheimer's just like humans. They can lose their memories, get lost, not recognize their master, and forget where their litterbox and food bowls are...
The lower the temperature is, the more active the tyrosinase in Siamese cats becomes and the more melanin they produce. Therefore, the colder it gets, the darker Siamese cats become.
There are many kinds of Siamese cats. If you like those with round faces, you can look into Thai cats. If you like those with sharper chins, you can look into modern Siamese cats.
The smallest cat breed acknowledged in the world right now is the Singapura.
Don't be shocked if you feel your cat is reacting to thin air. It might be interacting with ultraviolet light that we can't see.
Cats can tell a person's degree of focus. It knows if you're playing on your phone while you're playing with it.
If your cat is too active at night, you can try to play with it for 15 minutes before you sleep to burn off some of its energy. That way, all of you can have a good night's sleep.
Compared to a long, protracted bout, cats are more suitable for explosive bursts of movement.
Cats that suddenly start to run around the house at night are experiencing what is called "Midnight Crazies." This short burst of random activity can help them burn off excessive energy.

It is best for families with many cats to provide 1 extra litter box on top of the total number of cats (e.g., 3 boxes for 2 cats), more vertical space, and more food. More resources allow multiple cats to peacefully co-exist.
Sniffing each other's butts helps cats recognize each other and swap information.
When a cat rubs its head against you, it might be leaving behind its pheromones and marking you as its human.
Cats urinate 1-3 times a day on average.
Cats dream just like humans do.

Secrets of a litter box: The best location for a litter box is somewhere quiet and dry. The optimal length is 1.5 times the length of the cat, and it should be taller than the sitting height of the cat.
Maine Coons are one of the biggest cat breeds in the world. Mature Main Coon cats can grow longer than 1 meter.
Cats have no collarbone. Therefore, they can pass through any gap their heads fit through.
Cat litter should be at least 5 centimeters thick to provide the sensation preferred by cats and to cover the cat's scent enough to evade enemies tracking them.
When cats make a purring sound like a tractor, they are mostly expressing how happy or comfy they are.

The belly is one of the weakest points on a cat's body. For a cat to show its belly to you means it trusts you, or that this place is perceived as very safe. If you try to rub its belly, you might get bitten for betraying that trust.

A cat repeatedly using its front paws to knead a spot is an instinct kittens have to encourage their mother to give more milk. This habit might be kept into adulthood as a way to show enjoyment and satisfaction.
If you wake up to a mouse or cockroach by your bed, and your cat is watching from afar, don't panic. The cat might just be sharing the spoils of its hunt with you, or waiting for your praise.
Garlic, leek, and onions contain disulfides that can break down red blood cells, resulting in anemia in your cat.
Potatoes, tomatoes, and chilis contain solanine, which can make cats vomit, defecate blood, and have breathing problems.
Ear thermometers are a more gentle tool for taking a cat's temperature that they tend to find more acceptable.
A cat's body temperature is higher than that of humans. It is usually between 38 and 39.5 degrees Celsius.
A cat's whiskers can sense temperature and airflow. They can also measure distance.
The Chinese Mountain Cat is the only endemic cat species in China.
Kittens usually open their eyes 2-3 weeks into life. Their eyes are all blue at that stage, and they are unable to regulate their own temperature. You need to keep them warm!
The blue film over the eyes of young cats gradually shrinks away over 2-3 months, revealing the original color of the cat's irises.
After receiving the 3 vaccines, you can test for antibodies to assess whether your cat has successfully mounted a full immune response.

The passive immunity provided by your cat's mother will interfere with vaccine efficiency while protecting the baby cat. Therefore, it is best to wait until the kitten is two month's old for the first vaccine dose.
It's safer and more effective to use cardboard or a book to separate two fighting cats, compared to yelling or pulling the combatants apart with your hands .
A new cat arriving at your house needs to maintain its original diet for seven days before you can begin to slowly replace their food. Otherwise, the cat may develop digestive problems.
If a cat is hiding in a gap or cave out of fear, you can ignore it as long as that won't put it in danger. Intense human reactions can scare a cat even more.
Before you welcome a new cat home, you should clean in the gaps underneath tables, beds, wardrobes, and sofas. New cats may hide in these places out of fear.
Cat teaser rod tips - Part 1: Move like a bird, a mouse, and a snake. To be like a bird, "fly" the rod like a bird up and down and sideways in the air, occasionally perching on a high platform.
Cat teaser rod tips - Part 2: Move like a bird, a mouse, and a snake. To be like a mouse, move the rod close along the ground like a mouse, and rapidly "run" it away after approaching the cat.
Cat teaser rod tips - Part 3: Move like a bird, a mouse, and a snake. To be like a snake, move the rod like a snake in an S-pattern on the ground, occasionally hiding it in "crevasses."
Cats like frequent, short simulated hunts. Allowing the cat to catch the prey 1-3 times every 10 hunts can make the cat feel much more satisfied.
Being unable to catch prey for a long time will discourage the cat, so please do not use lasers or cat games on a tablet too often.
If you like the Abyssinian cat's ticked coat, muscular body, and explosive force, but also prefer long-haired cats, you can look into Somali cats.
If you like the color accents and long, slender body of the modern Siamese cat, but also prefer long-haired cats, you can look into Balinese cats.
Apart from the normal colors of black, white, and orange, there is also chocolate, blue, lilac, vanilla, and brown cat fur ...

Black cats with white spots on different parts of their body had different nicknames in ancient China. White belly - Cloud Over Snow; White tail - Needles in Ink; White-tipped tail - Pearls Dangling in Jade...
Abandoning a cat, alone, will not make the cat understand why it was abandoned or change its behavior. However, it may be traumatized by this change and run away, fall sick, or die.
Cats can eat 24 times more when they're with familiar people.

The "primordial pouch," which is a skin flap that stretches from a cat's belly to its hind legs, is mostly there to provide extra stretch capacity for its hind limbs and belly, to store energy, and to protect internal organs. It's not fat!
There are two cutaneous marginal pouches on a cat's ears. They are called "Henry's Pockets," and it is believed that they reduce low-pitched sounds to help enhance higher-pitched sounds.

When cats encounter a scent they can't distinguish, they will open their mouths and let the scent enter the vomeronasal organ between the roof of their mouth and nasal cavity. That way, cats can identify and remember the scent.
When a cat cannot discern how deep the water is, it will often dip its paw into the water to avoid accidentally choking by simply touching their nose to the water's surface.

When a cat already knows how deep the water is and the bowl doesn't put pressure on its whiskers, it may still touch the water with its paws. This may be because it wishes to have fresh water, or because it's simply having fun.
Cats' ancestors often played with their prey and only started eating once the prey had been exhausted and had no more fight left in it. This habit remains embedded in cat DNA today.
Designed to enhance seaside tourism in Quince, welcomes daily visitors who board yachts to admire the bustling city districts or engage in sea fishing and surfing.
Once a prominent hydroelectric power station in Southport, it was gradually replaced due to the rise of Pathos Technology. It was later leased by the Fishing Lodge and transformed into a fishery.
Located in the center of a saltwater lake in the western part of Yaozhou, this island offers fresh fish that tastes better than anywhere else's, perhaps due to the bumpy trip required to reach it.
Renowned for its high-quality water, Mussen Banks served as the royal water source for Leidsdam. The fish from this area are considered premium ingredients.
Situated in the Central District, this fishing spot can yield plenty of freshwater fish if you have the right tools.

Victor Hotel, situated in Boreala, is a unique cave hotel that seamlessly combines rugged and elegant elements. It attracts numerous couples who indulge in exquisite meals while gazing at the starlit waves, expressing their love. It is also the top spot for proposals in Catto City.

So, for me, Catto City is like my hometown... whereas I don't quite understand the situation in Yaozhou.

Ugh, why did they get elected then? In the end, they're making the position meaningless!
... In that case, certain proposals may be easily exploited.
Who says they aren't now? Maybe one day, when a real significant event occurs, they'll remember us.
Manager, I recently received a case.

Manager, do you usually watch sports? What sports do you like, and do you support any teams?
According to confidentiality principles, I can't reveal the specific details, but...

A cup of Carefree Green Tea.

If not, you should come to watch Vina! It's a safe investment!

I hope so... In her later years, she couldn't recognize me anymore and would often ask, "Why hasn't my little Bridger come home?"
I went to Quince District for high school, and I had never left home before. I never expected her memories to fix on that day.
So, Manager, from the beginning, I was thinking if I could use emotional energy to help her recognize me.
Human senses aren't entirely reliable, but emotions and memories should be real, right?
Anyway, I briefly considered trying to study this method by entering the Tower, but the Tower's requirements are too strict.
Strict to such a point... I realized I didn't have that talent, and I wasn't really from that world, anyway.
Although I say that now... you, advancing the progress of research through political means, are also on a path to realizing these ideals.
Alright, Manager! This is my promise to my grandma... and to you. I will do my best.

Not bad, you're from Yaozhou, after all.

Her partner suffers from Pathosis, on the brink of becoming Affliction, so she often sends wishes through messages in bottles, hoping the gods can receive them.
But... I'm no god, and without a specific address, I can't reply. I can only worry.
Was the message from Eventide Islands?
No, it came from the West Coast. So, I assume she's probably not from Catto City.
Help others while benefitting oneself. If Catto City has the capacity to help more people suffering from Pathosis, it would truly live up to the reputation of the “Ideal City."
Manager, have you been to the Judicial Zone? There have been quite a few cases undergoing trial recently.
Exactly! Vina is a powerhouse club in Catto City!
Recently? What about in the past...
It has been operating as usual, just that some cases are waiting on a prosecutor to return.
You might find it a bit exaggerated, but it's actually true.
I used to be a lawyer before becoming a Legislator in the House, and back then, the prosecutor and I stood on opposite sides in court.
I wonder how the Sunny Side Buns here taste.
After the trial, we went to a nearby Pathos Cuisine together... he really appreciated the Sunny Side Bun.
Is it because the combination of optimistic Pathos and buns is excellent?
Exactly. Manager understands the feelings of diners so perfectly...
His body is very weak, apparently due to a genetic issue, so he often needs to take breaks.
He mentioned that if people could experience the splendor of life in every meal, there would be nothing they couldn't do.
He's quite an optimistic and resilient person.
Frankly, Vina has all of Catto City's female soccer elite! Both humans and Felinians can join as long as they're skilled!
Your skills in preparing fish dishes are getting better. Even the salad tastes delicious.
You're too kind. Maybe Mr. Bridger is just in a good mood today.
Today, I ascended to the top of the Ivorus Institute!
Although it was just part of my work to inspect the area, the moment I stood on the top was still very touching.
Standing there, overlooking the Central District, no, all of Catto City, I felt like I was getting close to my dreams.
A tower needs to be built layer by layer, just as people climb it, step by step.
Manager, please hold out your right hand.
You can't even blink when watching their matches! If you look away for even a moment, you might miss an amazing goal!
Now hold out your left hand.
Well, I'll let you know when the food is served!
How strange. Manager, you're not from this world at all!
Your future line is elusive, and your origin line is connected with something; not all of it stays on your palm…
(... Could this be a real expert? This description sounds a lot like my situation with Naka and that countdown... )
Alright, please give me 500 Catto Coins.
Ah, you can trust my recommendation in this regard! This is all based on my years of experience!
Fortune-telling for good luck, it's a tradition... Or, this time you could give me a free meal. I'm not full yet.
Manager, how about I give you a fortune for good luck this time?
Don't worry, I'll pay for the meal.
Did you bring enough to cover the meal today?
Oh dear, I really came here to work this time! Quickly, let me look at your eyes.
Manager, there's a lingering gloominess between your eyebrows, and it's related to someone in the Central District.
Hehehe, judging by your expression, I'm right.
But don't worry, don't worry! I can tell from your eyes that there's no sign of impending doom. You'll be fine!
Look here—dispel! There you go, you're safe now!
They're that impressive… I see, I'll check out the atmosphere at the Chausie Stadium when I have some free time.
Oh, no need to thank me! Just treat this lovely Mr. Fortune-Teller to a serving of Invigorating Steamed Buns, and we're all good!
Sigh…I still can't figure it out.
Manager, you know my profession is fortune-telling, mainly through palmistry.
But... there are just so many Felinians in Catto City, and many cat customers come to me out of curiosity...
So? Isn't having a lot of customers a good thing?
... One day, my cat customer turned into a cat and showed me her paw pad.
I just can't figure it out—how the heck am I supposed to read a cat's paw?!
Impressive as always, Baker's Cafe! The interior and service are top-notch! I want to say that every time I come... You're really amazing, Manager!
(No wonder I declined Echo's proactive consultation last time... )
Why not just ask them not to transform into cats?
Well, you could tell them that... but it's quite discouraging. If we can't even read them in their true forms, it's like we're throwing away our livelihoods.
So, I can only study the connection between cat paw pads and human hands every day—no progress at all!
Manager, today Shiro also came to consult with me.
Shiro? She's an AI. Palmistry shouldn't work on her, right?
No, quite the opposite... I saw something very similar on Miss Shiro's hand that I've seen on yours.
It surprised me at first! But then I remembered...
My senior once told me that our divination is actually a perception and calculation of Pathos Particles.
So, the effect on Shiro might be because she spends a lot of time with you!
Thank you for the compliment... For the restaurant, customer satisfaction is the most important.
Can you describe this "something similar" in more detail?
Uh... it's hard to explain in words. In short, it's like a white cluster.
Also, let me tell you secretly, Manager... Ah, don't let Shiro know that I spilled the beans, okay?

Done something wrong? Can't an AI judge whether something is wrong or not? So I think it must be related to interpersonal matters...
... Although I'm still quite confused, thanks for letting me know.
I want to try milk tea today.
Manager, have you seen any strange people lately?
What kind of strange are we talking about?

That feeling of discomfort, as if someone is staring at you every time you come here!
Why would it make you uncomfortable if someone is watching me?
Because you, Manager, are my good friend, you provide a place where I can observe cat paw pads anytime... and you often give me snacks…
Alright! Anyway, Manager, you should be more vigilant. It's possible that more than one person is watching you!
Can you use your divination to figure out who they are?
Huh, if I could do that, I wouldn't always be hanging out here, right?

... Manager, I've been thinking of going back to my hometown in Yaozhou lately.
I miss the taste of home.
Since I came to Catto City, I haven't been back home even once.
You know about it, right? This place used to be very lively, then... suddenly it was taken over by Anomalies!
There are too many formidable people in Yaozhou... and...

I understand... or rather, I feel nearly the same way.
But I believe that fate is driven by our own hands, just as you need to look at our handprints in palmistry.
So even fish and chips can be delicious sometimes... sorry, that was a stereotype!
At first, there were just one or two, and we could handle it quickly. But then, the monsters kept growing in numbers, and even started causing casualties!
Huh, come to think of it, is this surprising feeling due to Pathos Cuisine bonus, or is it the fish and chips themselves?
It's probably a combination of both factors, making the surprising taste even stronger.
So... like our divination principles, in a way.
First, make people question, then overturn it entirely—add in the fact that my divination skills are quite something to begin with, and the final effect is naturally remarkable!
Sounds indeed quite professional... So, have you ready any palm prints for paw pads recently?
…Manager really knows how to bring up the awkward topic!

Only to be told, "The shape of paw pads is related to personality, we, Felinians, have long studied it, so there's no need for a fortune teller to make things up!"
Oh no, I forgot that both humans and Felinians love to study themselves...
Even just passing through here was very dangerous for ordinary people. Slowly, no one dared to come here anymore.
Please give me some Dried Fish!
Alright... Are you going to bribe the cats to show you their paw pads with these?
That's not bribery. It's a transaction!

But they can distinguish between the two without any mistakes, it's amazing!

Huh? That sounds more like a telepathic connection...
The taste of the cake is so sweet... it feels like...
I see, Mr. Bolin, you seem to know a lot about this area.
The pink cat lady who often visits Baker's Cafe asked me to predict something!
Ah, that seems to be the name... She's a lively high school girl.
Let's start with something to eat.

I have no idea how to predict love issues.
Don't keep quiet! We in the field of divination also have our specialties.
And this lady was so nervous that I couldn't even see the cat's paw pads, and she had an extended and widened version...
Did you tell her the truth?
Well, it's because of work. I'm always running around, so I know a bit more than the average person…
Well, I didn't lie... I said, fate is driven by our own hands!
And then, she slipped away when you weren't looking!
Manager, actually, when I first came to Catto City, I was looking for someone.
That person saved me when I was lost... I swore in my heart that I must...
Leaving aside the rest, "him"... ? Is it a male?
Yeah, strictly speaking, he's a male Felinian.
But can you read palm prints for paw pads?

... Five years is a much broader timeframe than you'd think.

Well... it's a challenging question. Are you facing some difficulties, Dora?
Exactly, as I just mentioned. The Ivorus Institute, is a place I've always dreamed of, a place I've been working towards...
They're at the forefront of cutting-edge technology! Their annual research and development outperforms others in both quantity and quality...
I've been making progress, but why do I feel further away from their standards? Is it because I'm not smart enough?
I heard some things... Hey, don't make that expression! It's really a big deal, something shocking!
Ah... I know that complaining won't help at all! Thank you, I'll keep working hard... I won't give up!
Dora, do you want to share something that made you happy?
Manager! Today is a lucky day for Dora! A happy day for Dora! I'm absolutely thrilled!
Our school hosted a lecture today. Guess who the guest speaker was?
It was Dr. Yunpei from the Institute of the Science Research Division! Ah, never dreamed that I'd get to see her!
Do you know? She's my ultimate idol! Do you have any idea how popular Dr. Yunpei is at our school?
The auditorium was almost empty at first, but within ten minutes of the news being released, there wasn't an empty seat left!
Dr. Yunpei is indeed amazing, but it's surprising that she has such an influence at the university...
She's not just amazing; she's super amazing! She's about our age, but her talent is outstanding...
I'm telling you; you mustn't tell anyone else!
In her field, I doubt there's any problem that could stump her. And she can completely restore damaged antiques...
Most importantly, she's always very gentle with us... Ah... How can someone be so perfect?
Haha... If Dr. Yunpei knew how much you admire her, she'd probably be delighted.
Manager, you must be careful when you go out.
Although Catto City has the best public order I've seen, there still seem to be some issues.
Lately, someone has been following me.
Right up until I came in the store, I could sense their presence.
It's strange... I'm not a wealthy person, so what could draw them to me? It's not like they can get much money from me.
Should we check the surveillance footage outside the store?
So, what is it? This is getting more and more curious...
I've tried, but no luck. I ran to the entrance of Spangler Group, and the nearby security personnel provided assistance.
However, there was no suspicious person in the surveillance footage... I'm starting to wonder if it's just my imagination.
Yeah, but there's no mistaking the feeling... Someone is watching me.
(It's likely an undercover soldier... they monitor the lives of incoming residents to ensure security.)
Sorry, that sounds a bit scary, doesn't it? But it's been about a month, and they haven't done anything to me... It should be fine.
Many things in the world seem to have reversed cause-and-effect.
If you encourage those Pathosis patients often, they seem to show some improvement from psychological suggestions.
Conversely, if you frequently criticize them, their symptoms worsen.
Yeah, that's right. So, the treatment of these patients also requires support from the people around them.
I heard that some members of StormEye disappeared mysteriously during their duty!
I've seen many people whose symptoms were initially not severe, but whose conditions worsened out of fear...
Is this treatment the cause or the result of their illness?
It's probably both. That's why we need to work harder to correct the public's misconceptions.
Haha... indeed, Manager, you're always so positive and enthusiastic.
It seems I haven't made a mistake coming to Catto City.
It looks like there are more members in the Cafe now? That's great.
Mr. Hardy, what have you been up to lately?
—They are members of StormEye! And it happened while they were on a mission, with their teammates!
Ah... I fainted due to low blood sugar in front of the factory and was hospitalized for a few days.
What? How are you doing now?
I'm much better now, don't worry!
A kind person took me to the hospital then. Unfortunately, I didn't get their contact information. I fainted and didn't even see what they looked like...
Good begets good. I'm sure that person is happy now.
Manager, did you know? Such kind people might be common for you, but for me...
Haha, it's nothing! Anyway, Catto City is really nice.
It's so fortunate to see Triss in Baker's Cafe...
That's no exaggeration... The most terrifying thing is that when they found him, he wasn't human anymore!
Mr. Hardy, are you also a fan of Triss?
Yes! When I had just moved to General Ward, I was lucky enough to see Triss' charity performance.
I still remember that evening. I woke up in a daze... and seeing that kind of sky, my mood got even worse.
It feels like I've wasted my life... and no one seems to care about me.
In the midst of those thoughts, Triss' singing suddenly came from outside the window!
There were too many people gathered, and I didn't dare to go downstairs, so I watched the entire performance by the window.
Mr. Hardy has a strong sense of safety. No wonder you were discharged so quickly.
Haha... after hearing too many reminders, I can't help but be this way.
... Mr. Bolin, it might be better not to spread such rumors indiscriminately.
Sorry, I can't help but daydream when I see you…
Because I was thinking, it would be great if my hometown had a place like Pathos Cafe... Maybe then, people with Pathosis wouldn't be subject to such disdain.
No, the Cafe is just one part of this system. To achieve that ideal, rules need to be thoroughly established from top to bottom.
You're right. No side should be left unchecked.
Just like... before I came to Catto City, I was diagnosed as severely Afflicted...
My hometown didn't have much research on Pathosis, so until I came here, I didn't know I was just a mild patient.
... and I had little hope to keep living.
Rumor? How could it be a rumor? I heard it with my own eyes... um, ears! It's spreading all over the streets and alleys...
Manager, did you participate in the recent shopping festival?
I've been quite busy lately, and haven't had the chance.
That's tough... but don't miss it!
After all, Catto's shopping festival is so much fun. I saw many imported products, and they were all genuine!
Mr. Hardy, how did you confirm their authenticity?
Well, because I traveled around the world in the past... I've been to many places and seen a lot of good things.
Although the conditions were tough at the time, I could only see them and thought I could never afford them.
Even though my current salary isn't much, buying a few collectables is still great!
Will Mr. Hardy continue traveling in the future?
Never mind, you don't have to believe it, but please be careful! Not just you, but your staff too!
I've walked so far, just seeing this oasis is satisfying enough.
One more Carnival Hot Dog, please!
One more Carnival Hot Dog, please!
Mr. Hardy has already ordered two servings of Carnival Hot Dogs today... do you like it that much?
No matter how much I eat, it's not enough!
Manager, do you know? There was a time when kind people would give me bread.
Not begging, but just laying at the roadside, probably looking thin and weak, and they thought I was having a hard time.
At that time, I suddenly realized that bread was especially delicious...
It's only now, after experiencing Pathos Cuisine, that I understand. Besides the bread itself, the kindness of others is also something that nourishes me.
But, Mr. Hardy, why were you lying at the roadside?
Don't take it lightly! This is Bolin's well-informed advice!
Because I finished the food I brought from my hometown...
Ah, no. I didn't think about it before setting off, that I could actually live that long?
Not just me, probably everyone in my hometown thought I had died from Affliction already...
The Grilled Eel here is just as good as the taste in Sakura Island!
Hmm... especially the sauce, it's perfect.
Sakura Island? I recall that it's challenging to get to Sakura Island.
Yes, even if you apply for a tourist visa, you can only stay for three days in the coastal area.
I had the privilege of going there because of my medical condition.
What could be better than a glass of Happy Soda!
Manager, as you know, I was a mild Pathosis patient before. But my hometown had a limited understanding of Pathosis and thought I was beyond help.
So, with the mentality of trying anything, I joined the same group of patients and boarded the "Heart's Wish" cruise to seek treatment on Sakura Island.
Sakura Island specializes in treating foreign patients...
Yes, and the diagnosis at that time was such that I couldn't stay on the island, so they sent me away... I was desperate, thinking the end was near.
But after coming to Catto City, I realized that I was wasting medical resources. Sakura Island meant that my condition didn't require staying on the island.
It's almost like the ones I saw at work. Does Manager have a hobby of collecting them?
It's something I just picked up during work.
Is that so? Your job is so varied...
Huh?... Oh! Manager, I'm really sorry, I didn't see you there!
Actually, I hadn't come across it before. In fact, my profession in my hometown is a foreign language teacher.
... A teacher? Although it's surprising, considering Mr. Hardy's manner of speaking, I guess it makes sense.
Thank you for the compliment... but, after all, to become a competent teacher, one should impart only accurate knowledge.
If I spread misinformation about Pathosis or make similar mistakes, what happened to me might happen to others in the future…
Hats off to you, Mr. Hardy.
Haha, maybe it's just an excuse I found for changing jobs.
This? It's a type of jade from Yaozhou, but I'm sorry, I can't give it to you. Its P-value is not suitable for human contact.
I know... it's called Jade of Happiness, right?
Strictly speaking, it's called Happy Fragments... But Mr. Hardy seems to have done some research on this?
No problem. I'm just curious, with you being so focused, what are you thinking about?
... My ex-girlfriend always wanted jade like this on her wedding ring.
It's not a big deal. People should always look forward. And if she knew I'm now healthy and recovered, maybe she would feel some small happiness.
She truly loved me... even though her parents didn't approve of us being together because of my Pathosis, she never gave up on me.
Sor... sorry. I just suddenly remembered what she looked like…whew.
Manager said Happy Fragments is not suitable for human contact, but at that time, we wanted to keep happiness forever at our fingertips...
Perhaps such plans were wrong from the beginning.
What do you think; is talent a necessary condition for success? Or can you achieve success through hard work and diligence alone?
... Miss Kathy, do you need any help?
Manager! I need a donation of 800,000!
It's okay, I'm okay, I'm fine…
So fine that I just realized I need another 800,000 to afford a house in the Quince District and be able to sit here and breathe the air!
If only I liked North District, I'd need to work for another fifteen years to afford a house in the suburban areas.
If only I liked Yaozhou District, I could become a security guard, working night shifts and living at the museum.
This question falls into the realm of philosophy...
If only I liked Central District... Ah, Central District is so expensive, I could never afford to live there even if I were to live a few more lifetimes…
What should I do, Manager? What should I do...
After this meal, let's all keep working hard...
Manager, are you wearing a work uniform? I've never seen you in casual clothes...
Well, that's because I'm at work.
I've always been curious about your outfits...
Or, Manager, how about trying a work uniform like Echo and the others?
A butler's uniform would be nice too!
Well, it's okay, I didn't expect to get any answers, I was just venting.
Wait, Manager, don't tell me your closet is filled with identical work uniforms... and you change into a fresh one every day?
Despite being a close friend of the big star, Triss... her outfits would cost half a year's salary for me!
Oh! We can learn from Minami's style, it's all about the delicate accessories!
But, a perfect body is required to pull it off.
Cheer up a bit, Miss Kathy...
Manager, I received an invitation from the Manyo Party!
It's that event attended by various young ladies—regularly held at the Banquet Hall in the Central District!
And, and I was personally chosen by Miss Ren, the host!
Wow? Congratulations... Are you going as a guest, Miss Kathy?
More or less, I'm going as a worker...
Do you know Linn-M? She's the Felinian streamer who's become really popular recently, Linn.
My base construction skills are top-notch, you know. No project I've overseen has ever gone wrong!
It seems they're bringing in new members for this Manyo Party, and she needs a garden-themed setting.
The job order they sent me specifies the need for a giant birdcage and freshly cultivated plants...
Manager, can you help me put in a good word? We need to make a purchase from the Four Seasons next door.
It's not that I want a kickback—mainly, I'm in charge of such an important task and want to save a little in case something unexpected comes up...
Understood. I'll do my best. Let's go talk to Felicia later.
Because I was too busy with work... and didn't have time to spend with him, so he broke up with me.
It's okay, Manager! I'm not sad at all.
And I didn't try to reconcile… It's like the principles of fixing a circuit. If you try to just connect a wire blindly, you might get hurt.
Miss Kathy is truly a carefree person.
Actually, it's because he is also Felinian.
Although the partner-bonds between humans and Felinians are quite common, it seems that many aspects require extra effort for both parties to understand each other.
For instance, every time I put in a lot of work to do a good job, my Felinian manager thinks it's something easily achievable, and that I'm just making a big deal out of nothing.
It's not that I want to say anything bad about Felinians, but, it's just that those with innate advantages tend to evaluate others from a superior viewpoint...
I absolutely don't want to become that kind of person!
Then, I'm going home to play games tonight!
Oh, by the way, Manager, do you want to add me as a friend? We can play shooting games together.
She's only in her teens, and yet, she's achieved such success. Is it because of her background, her appearance, or what?
But tonight... I might not have the time.
Right, Manager. You have a more demanding job than I do.
Then Kathy will have to play alone...
Hmph, first, I'll change the shooting targets to "Lewis"... !
Lewis? Does that mean Kathy's superior?
Oh no, not the one I often complain about. It's the immediate superior... You don't know? He fired my previous manager.
And it was handled in a way that made me uncomfortable... It's like he was fired because he was Felinian.
Of course, he publicly stated that it was due to downsizing in the organization—who would believe that? We're a public service institution!
Anyway, I don't like it when Felinians act high and mighty, and I don't like it when humans act high and mighty… Huh, does that mean I'm truly just a moral crusader?!
Age doesn't necessarily determine anything... Perhaps she's put in considerable effort behind the scenes as well.
Manager, as a friend of Triss, please evaluate me objectively and professionally—am I qualified to be an idol?
That's a sudden question... Is something wrong?
Our unit is holding a beauty pageant... I want to participate, but I'm being mocked...
Well, at least I can dance from start to finish with Triss and Erina's songs! I am also very, very healthy!
Does that mean only those who are exceptionally beautiful are qualified to be idols?
Not necessarily. In a broad sense, an idol refers to someone who has some outstanding quality that people recognize.
Alright, I've decided! Tomorrow, I'm going to replace all the water bottles in the indoor water dispenser. Let them see how capable I am!
Yep, from now on, I'll be called... Worker Idol Kathy-chan!
Talking about effort is meaningless... It's better to hide your sweat and tears and present a bright and glamorous facade to the public...
If I succeed, I'll help you promote products for free, Manager!
Manager, this morning when I passed by Baker's Cafe during my jog, you weren't there.
It's the perfect time for Ratfish Stew: protein after exercise!
Because I really wanted to chat with you, I did some anaerobic exercise at the entrance for quite a while.
Sorry, I was busy this morning.
Oh, by the way, let's get to the point... This morning, I wanted to talk about fitness.
Yeah! Through my long-term observations, many Felinians, although not visibly muscular, have excellent physical abilities from just regular exercise.
This should be related to them feeding on Pathos Particles, right?
Yes, the purer the Pathos Particles, the more beneficial they are to the health of Felinian.
You're right. Complaining and jealousy won't get you anywhere! I need to pull myself together!
Hehe, I've sniffed out a business opportunity...
Manager, you have many sides to you that seem strange but not entirely surprising…
Much like the impression you give as a person.
Yes! I rarely compliment others like this.
And that gear reminds me of my mom and dad...
Because there's really not much to talk about... These two, they met through online dating, you know?
They claimed to be Felinians online and even created avatars of themselves as Felinians... They got into a hot romance thinking they were of similar status.
Only by becoming strong on your own can you get the chance to collaborate with big streamers like Linn. My success is just around the corner!
Until they met and found out they were both lying... but they were already deeply in love by then.
One claimed to be a Felinian Legislator of the House of Representatives, and the other simply said she was a noble lady... Turns out they worked on the same street!

Every time they tell this story, they emphasize the importance of recognizing their own value and want me to understand that even if you're just one cog in the machine, you can still enjoy life to the fullest.
So, I hope that the hardworking Manager, who always seems to be busy with other people's affairs, can take better care of yourself and rest occasionally...
When I was a child, my Felinian friends always turned into kittens to drink milk.
So cute... The human teachers always said this, and before I knew it, I never got my own share!
And this sort of thing still happens...
And they are indeed cute... So I let them have it.
Thinking back, it was really a cunning move—had I known, I should have claimed that I had Pathosis back then, and I would collapse if I didn't drink milk.
Miss Kathy couldn't make up lies like that... and she seems healthier than anyone.
Great, I've found the next direction for my efforts! Thank you, Manager!
Please give Super Kathy a glass of milk!
Hehehe, isn't that right? I'm Super Kathy, who exercises every day! My goal is to live a healthy life and still work at a hundred!
Because the cost of living is too high, and if you want to keep getting everything you like, you have to keep working.
Oh, by the way, Manager, if you're thinking about losing weight, don't go for skim milk when drinking milk. That's a fitness misconception!
Whole milk is better—just like dreams, it's the big ones that are the most nutritious.
—Th-this Crispy Hairtail, did you make it?!
It was me, Miss Kathy. Is there anything you're not satisfied with?
No, I am too satisfied! Manager, where did you buy the fish?
I caught it at the Spya Reservoir.
Huh, why are the ones I catch there always so small...
Never mind. Next time you go fishing, please let me come and watch—take me on as your disciple!
Because Kathy has recently made friends with a Felinian and wants to give her a gift.
After thinking about it, fish dishes seem to be the most suitable…
And by personally fishing and cooking, the other person should be able to feel my sincerity, right?
Miss Kathy is very concerned about that friend.
... Actually, as I grew up, I found that Felinians have some obvious social advantages, and I had a little dislike for them.
But because I often come into contact with Baker's Cafe and everyone else, I started to realize that sometimes I treat them differently...
Even though in many situations, the circumstances of humans and Felinians are similar.
Mr. Bolin, please keep it down...
So—from now on, Kathy wants to become an honest friend with Felinians! Master!
She's already calling me Master directly...
Can I have a refill of water?
Please wait, it'll be ready in a moment.
Thank you. I talked too much this morning during the speech; I'm so thirsty.
Ah, I have to rush to Boreala in the afternoon. I hope the residents there can stay calm!
Boreala is a military area, so you need to be cautious when doing things there.
That's true. But I've already figured out their needs to a point.
After all, a speech is essentially the art of framing one's thoughts, making the audience believe that you genuinely stand in their shoes.
The residents of Boreala have always needed...
Ah, Manager! Sorry, I forgot... That was amazing!!
Haha, we're getting too chatty. If I say too much, I might end up being dismissed.
Is that not appropriate to say? How old do I look to you?
Around the same age as me, a young person.
Those elderly folks in the House of Representatives say I look too young and unreliable.
So, I tried to imitate their style... Obviously, it failed.
It's strange. Felinians can stay forever young, so nobody judges their abilities based on appearance.
